title: H4 rebase 2: rebase task/T-0427 (the fourteen-commit H4 chain) onto goal/T-0353 at ccaa601, resolving orchestrator/daemon.py against the merged H7 failure-kind and rerun changes, keeping both intents; full gate green twice (merge conflict on T-0427)
spec:
STEP 0: this worktree is cut from task/T-0427 (H4 chain: fourteen commits from 7087be9 through 3a8271e over base 9b058ab). Rebase it onto goal/T-0353 (head ccaa601, which now carries H7: failure_signature and failure_kind, flaky rerun with validated ids, worktree-scoped runner probe with timeout, resume compatibility, plus the fix-round packet changes). The daemon's merge reported rebase_conflict in exactly one file: orchestrator/daemon.py, where H7 added failure_kind, _test_ids validation, _flaky_rerun_command and its probe near the top of the module and changed auto_fix_round, while the H4 chain changed dispatch (reservation-free, slots only), reconcile_dead(t, pool), the notify-per-transition calls and the worker-call shape.
Steps: run git rebase goal/T-0353 in this worktree; for each conflict in orchestrator/daemon.py keep both intents: all H7 helpers and the auto_fix_round changes exactly as merged, and all H4 changes from the chain; keep every test from both sides. After the rebase the branch must show the fourteen H4 commits re-applied on top of ccaa601 with no merge commit. Then run .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh from the worktree root twice (exit 0 both) and python -m unittest tests.test_daemon tests.test_pool tests.test_executor once more. If conflicts appear outside daemon.py, resolve them keeping both intents and list them. The rebase is the commit; if a resolution fix is needed, commit it with the task id. Report the new head sha, resolved files and failures only.
acceptance: git log --oneline in the worktree shows ccaa601 (goal/T-0353 head) below the fourteen re-applied H4 commits and no merge commit

orchestrator/daemon.py keeps H7's failure_kind, failure_signature, validated rerun ids and bounded probe together with H4's reservation-free dispatch, reconcile_dead(t, pool) and notify-per-transition calls (grep for def failure_kind, def failure_signature, def reconcile_dead(t, pool)
python -m unittest tests.test_daemon tests.test_pool tests.test_executor exits 0
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree on two consecutive runs
